## Batch 95 authoring complete

I drafted the 12 A-page items and 2 B-page examples, added local suppliers for the \(\nu^-\) genus estimate and slice-complex stable splitting, and updated the manifest, proof contracts, coverage, source evidence, cross-batch dependencies, and notes. The A/B pages remain YAML-only with empty bodies. All 14 items are recorded as **escalated**.

Scoped checks passed: proof layout (14 items, 45 steps), content policy, render check (16 files), dependency check, coverage checklist, source fetch (11/11), and strict proof contracts (14/14). The source notes record that Hom–Wu’s Proposition 2.4 cites Rasmussen for the genus proof rather than supplying it locally ([Hom–Wu](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1401.1565)); the Upsilon regrading gap is also explicit ([Livingston, §15](https://www.maths.gla.ac.uk/~mpowell/Upsilon-revised.pdf)).

The run-wide item-level check still reports four mismatches in unassigned batch 98 items, and batch dependency levels are stale. Autopilot remains at `1-scaffold`, with batches 77, 95, 99, and 109 missing and an owner repair/recertification blocker. I left those shared inputs and engine state unchanged.

The slice-helper’s decorated-annulus dependency and the final Upsilon normalization clarification were added after its escalation record was written. I preserved the escalation and documented the additions in the notes, contracts, and dependency ledger.

See the [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-95.notes.md), [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-95.pages.json), and [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/inverse-problems-knot-theory-all-109-2026-10-19-batch-95.proof-contracts.json).
